question: Advisor headcount over the last eight quarters across the five.

claims.text: Edward Jones's 10-Q for the quarter ended June 26, 2026 (published 2026-08-07) reports financial advisors (actual) at period end of 19,647 in the U.S. and 867 in Canada. The year-earlier comparatives are 19,435 and 874. The filing prints the two countries in separate columns, and no combined total is stated in the evidence.
Edward Jones's 10-Q for the quarter ended September 26, 2025 (published 2025-11-07) reports 20,429 financial advisors (actual) at period end, against 19,885 a year earlier (+3%).
Edward Jones's 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2025 (published 2025-08-08) reports 20,309 financial advisors (actual) at period end, against 19,589 a year earlier (+4%).
Raymond James's FY2025 10-K (published 2025-11-25) states it had 8,943 employee and independent contractor financial advisors affiliated with it as of September 30, 2025.

On the fiscal Q4 2025 earnings call (published 2025-10-22), Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm ended the fiscal year with a record number of financial advisors, 2% higher than the prior year. No count is given in that passage.

adjacent.text: Bank of America's 2025 investor day deck (published 2025-11-05) shows ">15K" wealth advisors for "Merrill | Private Bank" in its Global Wealth & Investment Management slide. It is a single approximate figure with no quarterly series.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's. It is also one approximate undated figure, not a quarterly count.

adjacent.text: A Bank of America GWIM supplement (published 2024-01-12) shows total wealth advisors of 18,916 at period end for the quarter ended 2023-12-31. Earlier quarters in that table are 19,130, 19,099, 19,243 and 19,273.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank, so these are not Merrill's figures. The footnote says the count also includes advisors in Consumer Banking. The periods are 2023, outside the last eight quarters.

adjacent.text: A Morgan Stanley Wealth Management supplement (published 2021-01-20) shows 15,950 Wealth Management representatives at Dec 31, 2020, 15,469 at Sep 30, 2020 and 15,468 at Dec 31, 2019.
adjacent.differs_because: These are Morgan Stanley Wealth Management representatives for 2019 and 2020, outside the last eight quarters. No recent quarterly count is in the evidence.

adjacent.text: On the Q3 2026 earnings call (published 2026-10-15), Schwab CEO Rick Wurster said the firm serves more than 16,000 firms representing $5.8 trillion in assets in its adviser business.
adjacent.differs_because: This counts independent advisory firms served and their assets, not individual advisors. It is a single point in time, not a quarterly series.

adjacent.text: Schwab management said it is hiring financial consultants and wealth advisers: on the Q1 2026 call (April 2026), "We're continuing to hire financial consultants and wealth advisers." The Q2 2026 10-Q (published 2026-08-07) cites growth in headcount, including financial consultants and wealth advisors, as a driver of compensation expense.
adjacent.differs_because: These are qualitative statements about hiring direction. They give no number of financial consultants or Schwab Wealth Advisory advisors.

gaps.what: Morgan Stanley: a quarterly Wealth Management financial advisor or representative count for the last eight quarters is not in the evidence provided. Only a 2020 figure appears.
gaps.suggested_source: Morgan Stanley quarterly Financial Supplement, Wealth Management metrics page, or the 10-Q/10-K Wealth Management statistics

gaps.what: Merrill does not report standalone results.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America quarterly earnings supplement (GWIM advisor count), noting that its scope covers GWIM and not Merrill alone

gaps.what: Raymond James: quarterly advisor counts for the other seven of the last eight quarters are not in the evidence provided. Only 8,943 at September 30, 2025 and a qualitative year-over-year comment are available. There is also no split by employee, independent contractor and RIA & Custody Services channels.
gaps.suggested_source: Raymond James quarterly earnings press release and financial supplement (PCG financial advisor counts by channel)

gaps.what: Edward Jones: advisor counts for Q4 2024, Q1 2025, Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q3 2026 are not in the evidence provided. The Q1 2026 table is cut off before the figure. The Q2 2026 count is given only as separate U.S. and Canada figures.
gaps.suggested_source: Edward Jones 10-Q/10-K 'Financial advisors (actual)' tables and the Q4 2025 10-K

gaps.what: Schwab: a count of independent advisors served, or of Schwab Wealth Advisory advisors and financial consultants, by quarter is not in the evidence provided. Schwab discloses firms served and assets, not advisor headcount.
gaps.suggested_source: Schwab quarterly Advisor Services statistics (RIA clients and firms served) in the 10-Q or earnings supplement; investor-day materials for financial consultant and wealth advisor counts
